body:
`apps/chrome-ext/public/manifest.json` exposes:

| Key | Value | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `manifest_version` | 3 | MV3 is mandatory for new Web Store submissions |
| `action` | `{ default_title }` | Toolbar icon → service worker opens the viewer tab |
| `background.service_worker` | `service-worker.js` (module) | Dev WS reload + icon click |
| `content_scripts` | `content.js` on `file:///*` | `file://` URL interception |
| `options_ui` | `src/options/index.html`, `open_in_tab: true` | Settings page |
| `permissions` | `["storage"]` | chrome.storage.sync + session |
| `web_accessible_resources` | `src/app/index.html`, `assets/*` matched on `file:///*` + `<all_urls>` | Lets the content script redirect `file://` → extension tab |

Four bundle entries go through Vite (`vite.config.ts`):

| Entry | Output | Consumer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `app` | `src/app/index.html` + hashed assets | viewer tab |
| `options` | `src/options/index.html` + hashed assets | options page |
| `service-worker` | `service-worker.js` (fixed name) | background worker |
| `content` | `content.js` (fixed name, IIFE) | content script |

The fixed filenames for `service-worker.js` and `content.js` are pinned in
`vite.config.ts:entryFileNames` because `manifest.json` references them
by name. **If you rename one you must rename the other.**
